facts.summary: Closed and unblinded trials after clinical hold for liver failure case · Phase 2b/2a · zelnecirnon in atopic dermatitis and asthma · not yet approved

evidence.summary: it has decided to close and unblind both its Phase 2b clinical trial of zelnecirnon (RPT193) in atopic dermatitis (“AD”) and its Phase 2a trial of zelnecirnon in asthma.
evidence.safety: Both clinical trials were placed on clinical hold by the FDA in February 2024 based on a serious adverse event of liver failure requiring transplant in one patient in the AD trial.
